'''Uquine''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Uquine system/Legends|Uquine system]] of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].

==History==
Uquine became part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by around [[22,000 BBY/Legends|22,000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> In [[10,966 BBY]], the [[Pius Dea]] [[Pius Dea|Faithful]] were decimated by the combined forces of the [[Renunciates]], [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]], the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], and the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]], ending the [[Seventh Alsakan Conflict]] and the [[Pius Dea Era]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
